protocol: MOKOSMART BeaconX Pro FEAB service advertisement

source.name: Theengs Decoder MBXPRO protocol facts

source.notes: BeaconX Pro/H4 uses frame type 0x40 for voltage, 0x60 for acceleration+voltage and 0x70 for temperature+humidity+voltage. BLE profile v1 has no per-field frame conditions, so frameType plus raw words are exposed safely instead of reporting values under the wrong frame type.
